shared_elements: human head with facial features (eyes, mouth)
hair/headdress rendered as rows of rounded curls or lobes
justification: The only real correspondence is a human head whose hair is rendered as stacked rows of rounded curls or lobes, a fairly generic convention. Otherwise A is a multi-figure profile relief scene of a winged anthropomorphic figure with raised arm, bucket-like object, rosettes, a plant/staff and a line of inscribed signs, while B is a single frontal head in the round with no scene, no attributes and no accompanying motifs.
